title: Home Buying Tips You NEED to Know in 2025 | Smart Advice for First-Time & Repeat Buyers
description:
Home Buying Tips You NEED to Know in 2025 | Smart Advice for First-Time & Repeat Buyers

Are you thinking about buying a home this summer? 🏡 Whether you're a first-time buyer or upgrading your lifestyle, this episode of the Working Moms podcast breaks down the must-know tips for navigating today's real estate market—especially in Central Texas (Austin, Georgetown, Belton, Temple).

Gloria and Marisa share expert buyer advice, including:
Why it's currently a buyer’s market (and what that really means)

-How to narrow your home search before touring
-Choosing the right location based on lifestyle, schools, healthcare, and accessibility
-Understanding wants vs. needs — and how to avoid homebuyer’s remorse
-How to shop smart within your budget and avoid future regrets
-Why loving your home truly matters 💛

We also talk about how your realtor can help guide you through selecting the right community, assessing local amenities, and preparing financially for the realities of homeownership.

🎧 Tune in now and make smarter home buying decisions today!
👇 Got questions? Drop them in the comments — we might answer them in our next episode!
